_README: Per-drug/weight-band DOSE TITRATION LADDER transcribed VERBATIM from Dr. Barbour's final_doses_titration_v9.xlsx. verified:true for bands she supplied (confirmed 2026-10-25, NEEDS_PI_SIGNOFF #70). Bands named in data_quality_flags stay verified:false. Each band gives the explicit dose ladder: pre_maintenance_increments (below goal, cols Q-Y), min_maintenance_dose (col Z = the minimum maintenance / goal), up_increments (tolerated increases above goal, cols AA-AI up to effective_max), and high_increments_often_not_tolerated (cols AJ-AP; reaching these triggers the dagger labs in high_dose_labs_by_drug). The engine reads these EXPLICIT cells; it does NOT recompute doses. _helper_columns are the sheet's derivation columns, kept for provenance only. See data_quality_flags for cells Kristen must confirm (NOT auto-corrected here, per defer-on-ambiguity).
provenance_note: Bands are hers (v9, confirmed 2026-10-25). A band in data_quality_flags is still unverified.

lamotrigine._source: Asterisk footnote in final_doses_titration_v6.xlsx: 'LamoTRIgine* ... *For patients NOT receiving valproate and NOT receiving enzyme-inducing antiseizure medications.' Transcribed VERBATIM (routing metadata, not an invented clinical value).
lamotrigine.note: These lamotrigine rungs apply ONLY to patients NOT on valproate and NOT on an enzyme-inducing ASM. For a patient on valproate (raises lamotrigine levels -> higher SJS/TEN risk) or an enzyme inducer, this ladder does NOT apply: suppress it and titrate with the much slower conmed-specific regimen (see asm_rules.json lamotrigine 'WITH valproate' / 'WITH enzyme inducer' bands). The WITH-valproate and WITH-inducer bands are not on this sheet and stay unverified.

high_dose_labs_note: Order these when the patient reaches the high_increments_often_not_tolerated range (cols AJ-AP), if applicable to the current medication (footnote dagger).
